startups.headline: Rement recovers circular raw materials from demolition concrete and stores CO2 in the process. We increase…
startups.description:
Rement is a cleantech startup addressing one of the biggest environmental challenges of our time: concrete. As the second most consumed material on Earth after water, concrete production is responsible for over 8% of global CO₂ emissions and massive extraction of natural resources. Rement has developed a groundbreaking technology that recovers high-quality circular raw materials from demolition concrete while permanently storing CO₂ in the process. Our system multiplies the material value of waste concrete by a factor of 30 and reintegrates these valuable resources—such as sand, reactive cement additives, and ultra-pure calcium carbonate—into regional production loops.



Unlike conventional downcycling, Rement enables construction recyclers and cement producers to tap into new revenue streams and dramatically reduce emissions. Our patented process is the only one that can energy-efficiently separate fine concrete fractions into pure, marketable components. The resulting materials are competitive with virgin resources in both quality and price, but come with a significantly better carbon footprint. One Rement plant avoids the extraction of 50,000 tons of raw material and stores 5,000 tons of CO₂ per year, contributing directly to SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption) and SDG 13 (Climate Action).



Backed by a passionate team of six engineers from the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), we are currently at Technology Readiness Level 5. Our pilot passed the 24h continuous run test. MoU for FOAK and NOAK signed.

jobs.title: VP or Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Karlsruhe (on-site or hybrid) | Full-time



About Rement

At Rement, we are re-engineering concrete waste to enable a circular construction industry. We develop concrete upcycling plants that turn concrete waste and CO₂ into high-quality, sustainable materials—creating real economic and environmental impact.

We are a mission-driven team that thinks big, moves fast, and builds with purpose—working to make sustainable construction the default at scale.



Your Mission

As VP or Head of Engineering, you will scale our technology from pilot to our first commercial FOAK (first-of-a-kind) plant.

You act as the right hand to the CTO and join the leadership team alongside CEO and COO. Your role is to translate R&D into industrial reality—owning the path from lab to large-scale deployment.



What You Will Do



Scale-up & Deployment



·       Lead the development of our first industrial plant from pilot to commercial scale

·       Define process design packages, drive equipment specification, and ensure engineering readiness

·       Manage interfaces with EPC/engineering partners and support permitting processes



Engineering Leadership



·       Shape and execute Rement’s engineering and scale-up strategy together with the CTO

·       Build and lead our future engineering organization (scale-up team starting 2026–2027)



R&D & Technology Translation



·       Align R&D activities with business and engineering goals

·       Translate scientific insights into process, product, and scale-up decisions

·       Structure and steer the R&D portfolio toward industrial impact



External Collaboration & Market Readiness



·       Build partnerships with universities, industrial partners, and customers

·       Drive material validation, certification, and compliance (e.g., EN/DIN standards)



What We Are Looking For



·       Degree in Process, Chemical, Mechanical, or Automation Engineering (or similar)

·       8+ years of engineering experience, ideally in plant engineering or industrial environments

·       3+ years of leadership experience

·       Proven track record in scaling technologies (pilot → industrial / FOAK)

·       Availability from Q3 2026



Plus:



·       Experience in construction materials, cement, or material science

·       Exposure to climate tech, CO₂ utilization, or circular economy



You bring:



·       Strong ability to turn complex science into practical engineering solutions

·       Excellent communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders

·       Hands-on, ownership-driven mindset with a passion for climate impact



What Rement offers



·       A Senior Leadership role with high stragic impact, with potential to grow into a C-level position

·       High ownership and freedom to shape engineering direction and partnerships

·       Opportunity to bring a breakthrough climate technology to industrial scale

·       Fast-paced environment with real responsibility and execution speed

·       Strong network across industry and leading research institutions

·       Access to modern lab and technical infrastructure

·       Support for conferences, publications, and thought leadership

·       Competitive salary + equity participation

·       30 days vacation and flexible, trust-based culture

·       A mission-driven team building solutions for one of the world’s largest CO₂ challenges



Ready to Build the Future of Circular Construction?



Apply via jobs@rement.tech and join us in turning concrete waste into the foundation of a sustainable future.

More on www.rement.tech.

startups.headline: VISS builds patented hardware endpoint security that physically decouples data streams, making remote…
startups.description:
VISS – “The Condom for your PC”



VISS is building a new foundation for endpoint cybersecurity. While most security solutions attempt to defend systems through increasingly complex software, VISS takes a fundamentally different approach: it removes the possibility of remote compromise altogether.



At the core of VISS, is it´s patented cybersecurity hardware that physically decouples the data stream between the internet and the protected endpoint. Instead of allowing direct digital communication, VISS enforces strict isolation through physics. As a result, malware, zero-day exploits, and even nation-state attacks cannot reach the endpoint, because there is no attackable data path.



This approach addresses a structural weakness of modern computing: software cannot reliably secure systems that software itself can compromise. By shifting trust from code to hardware-enforced isolation, VISS establishes a security layer that is independent of operating systems, applications, and updates. VISS is incubated by the worlds leading cybersecurity research institute: CISPA Helmholtz Institute for Information Security as well as supported by KASTEL Security Research Labs and KIT Gründerschmiede. 



The technology is designed as a dual-use solution. It protects civilian users, enterprises, and critical infrastructure, while also meeting the stringent requirements of defence and high-assurance environments. VISS is supported by NATO DIANA, reflecting its relevance for both civilian resilience and military security.



VISS pursues a long-term, civilization-scale ambition: to become the standard security component embedded in every PC and critical endpoint worldwide. Just as firewalls and encryption became essential layers of digital infrastructure, VISS aims to make physical endpoint isolation a default assumption of secure computing.



By enforcing security through hardware and physics rather than software alone, VISS seeks to redefine how the world protects its most critical digital assets.



Join us on this mission.

startups.name: Photreon
startups.headline: Hydrogen from just sunlight and water: From solar photons to sustainable values.
startups.description:
Vision

photreon stands for green hydrogen from just sunlight and water. We make low-cost solar panels for cost-efficient green hydrogen production.

Problem

Currently, green hydrogen is expensive. It cannot establish itself in the market: high investment cost for production plants, high operational costs and additional expenses in the supply chain render green hydrogen a costly feedstock and energy carrier.

Solution

The photreon solar panel offers a solution: Due to its patent protected geometry (patent pending) the panel collects sunlight efficiently and independently of the sun’s position over the course of the day and uses it to split water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen. The panel is manufactured from low-cost polymers via established and scalable mass fabrication techniques. Thereby, the photreon technology allows customers to produce hydrogen at low levelized cost and has the potential to revolutionize the hydrogen market.

Mission

Our mission is the commercialization of the photreon technology. We provide an attractive alternative to established electrolysis technology and aim for lowered costs, supporting the hydrogen market ramp up. 

Markets

With our engineering and business administration expertise we aim to establish the photreon technology in two markets.

First, via world-scale production in the global sunbelt by global acting energy companies: The utilization of vastly available solar energy via photovoltaic is limited by the challenge to transport green electric energy from remote areas to the industrial centres for instance in Europe. In this scenario, hydrogen acts as an energy vector making captured solar energy globally transportable. The photreon technology can play its full strength due to its low investment costs per installed synthesis power. No expensive electrolysers or power electronics are needed. On the vast available areas, hydrogen can thereby be produced at extremely low levelized costs.

Second, to serve small to medium-scale hydrogen consumers in industrial countries: hydrogen consumers in these markets rely on purchasing hydrogen supplied via trailers, tied to high transport costs and dependence on delivery chains. A local production of hydrogen via electrolysis is unattractive due to the high system complexity and investment costs. Due to its simplicity and low investment costs, the photreon technology allows those small to medium-scale hydrogen consumers to become hydrogen prosumers. The production cost is independent of price fluctuations in the energy market and uncertainties in the delivery chain.



Join us on the journey to the future of low-cost green hydrogen produced from just sunlight and water!



Funding / Support

We are preparing for public research transfer programs such as EXIST Forschungstransfer. While our work is personnel-intensive, it remains comparatively low in capital requirements despite involving a hardware product. We have secured Helmholtz Enterprise FSF and are actively looking for mentors.
